children: TAP Real Estate Technologies announced two agreements tied to the Zermatt Resort in Midway, Utah. The company acquired a 2% equity interest in Alpenhaus Resort by transferring its option to purchase the property; Alpenhaus closed the acquisition from Wasatch Springs the same day. Separately, TAP entered a one-year, auto-renewing Technology Services Agreement to deliver digital infrastructure and access to its real estate technology platform, for a $60,000 upfront fee and $6,000 per month. The services deal also grants TAP exclusive rights to any tokenization services for the resort under separate agreements, reinforcing both strategic alignment and recurring revenue.
